name: Squat (Low Bar)
instructions: Rest the barbell low on your rear delts, below the traps.
Take a slightly wider stance and sit back more than a high-bar squat.
Descend until hip crease is below the knee.
Drive up, keeping the chest forward-inclined. Lets most lifters move maximal weight.
longevityNotes: Keep the squat pattern for life: depth and control matter more than load. Train it pain-free, leave reps in reserve, and your knees and hips will thank you at 80.
overview: Squat (Low Bar) is an intermediate lower-body exercise that builds the quadriceps, usually performed with a barbell. It trains the deep knee-and-hip bend you use every time you sit, stand, or climb stairs.
